name: Project 2 healthy simulation jig
reference: Logical/motor/motorCyclic.ld:49-71: raw contacts required by the inch/start interlock
Logical/motor/motorCyclic.ld:695: DC bus contact is negated in the active start network
Logical/motor/motorCyclic.ld:1196: Non-CE FAST start requires drafting door closed (raw 1).
Logical/fault/faultCyclic.ld:1213-1226: empty can present is raw 1; missing raw 0 for 6 s raises the original alarm.
Logical/motor/motorCyclic.ld:65-67,125-127,840-845: top-arm closure must remain present while drafting load changes, or readiness and FAST latch drop.
assumptions: Virtual commissioning defaults, not measured physical machine states. All contacts remain editable.
MACHINE_OFF buttons are released at 1 and pressed at 0 in this configuration.
Unspecified contacts keep their configured value. Mechanical timing, gearing and pulse resolution are editable jig assumptions.

The reviewed simulation source guards preserve target settings and display zero for unavailable zero-weight Hank feedback. Nonzero conversions and process settings remain source-driven; this convention is not physical machine validation.

Selected IoMap.iom:69 maps ANALOG_VOLT_INVERTER to the delivery inverter analog output. Bind this PLC command instead of a fixed frequency. The generic bench assumes 0..32767 counts means 0..50 Hz; edit the reference scale to match the actual drive voltage/frequency calibration.

Selected IoMap.iom:79 maps AO_TO_SERVO to the servo analog output. ALscan/Main.st:480 writes voltage times 3276.7 counts. The generic bench assumes signed -32768..32767 counts spans approximately -3000..3000 RPM; edit the reference scale and motor/encoder coupling to match the actual servo configuration.

deviceOverrides.name: ED_DO_INVERTER_START / encoder
replacesAssumptions: Counter01 and DigitalInput01 belong to the delivery-counter module in IoMap.iom. The virtual VFD shaft supplies the bench speed. Resolution 1024 pulses/revolution and 1:1 shaft coupling are editable simulation assumptions; confirm gearing for quantitative delivery-speed checks.
deviceOverrides.reason: Counter01 and DigitalInput01 belong to the delivery-counter module in IoMap.iom. The virtual VFD shaft supplies the bench speed. Use a conservative 1 effective pulse per modeled motor revolution. The active len_delCyclic.ab:80-85 sets DELIVERY_METRE_PER_PULSE to 0.00999, giving 14.985 m/min at 1500 RPM. Resolution and coupling are editable bench assumptions, not measured machine calibration; enter actual gearing for production-speed checks.

deviceOverrides.name: DI_TOP_ARM
deviceOverrides.reason: The healthy jig starts with the top arm closed (raw 0). Keep this contact independent of DO_DRAFTING_LOAD: deriving it from that output with travel delay drops M1200 and cancels M1231 at motorCyclic.ld:840-845 before feedback arrives. Toggle this editable contact explicitly to model opening the arm; no PLC interlock is forced.

deviceOverrides.name: DI_MAIN_MOTOR_FAST
deviceOverrides.reason: The source latches FAST while drafting load is confirmed. Drafting-load confirmation uses a 1 s TON, while releasing FAST starts a 1 s cancellation timer (motorCyclic.ld:872-899). A 2 s jig press allows the normal load feedback/start sequence; editable in Configure.

deviceOverrides.name: DO_ENABLE_TO_SERVO_DRIVE / encoder
deviceOverrides.reason: The scanning encoder count feeds B4ScanningPulse; its shaft follows the servo. Resolution and gearing are editable jig assumptions. B4Freq and the original scan-encoder monitor evaluate this feedback.

deviceOverrides.name: DI_DRAFTING_LOAD
deviceOverrides.reason: Virtual load-confirmation switch follows DO_DRAFTING_LOAD with editable 150 ms actuator travel.

deviceOverrides.name: DI_SCANNING_LOAD
deviceOverrides.reason: Virtual load-confirmation switch follows DO_SCANNING_LOAD with editable 150 ms actuator travel.

deviceOverrides.name: DI_SUCTION_MONITOR
deviceOverrides.reason: Pressure-switch feedback follows the fan with an editable 500 ms pressure build/decay delay. faultCyclic.ld:687-701 raises suction-box-full when the fan runs without this input for 5 s in pressure-switch mode.

deviceOverrides.name: AI_SUCTION_PRESSURE
deviceOverrides.reason: Fan pressure ramps toward REQUIRED_SUCTION_PRESSURE. Raw scaling in mainCyclic.ab:1927 is pressure = ADC * 5000 / 32767, so jig ADC = requested pressure * 6.5534. Response rate is editable.
